title: WHEN AI AGENTS DISAGREE LIKE HUMANS: REASONING TRACE ANALYSIS FOR HUMAN-AI COLLABORATIVE MODERATION
reasoning: The paper explores 'value pluralism' and how agents weight competing moral and social values (e.g., harm prevention vs. free expression) in the context of hate speech moderation. It specifically cites and applies theories of moral judgment (Haidt) to analyze disagreement patterns as a signal for human-like evaluative conflict.
